species: C67BL/6 N mice (as stated in text)
readout_other: Neurological Severity Score (NSS); Y-maze spontaneous alternation; hippocampal CA1 local field potential power (delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma bands); BrdU+/NeuN+ and Dcx immunofluorescence; hippocampal RNA-seq and non-targeted metabolomics; scratch-wound migration and neurite outgrowth in primary cortical neurons
direction_notes: LIPUS increased hippocampal neurogenesis (BrdU+/NeuN+, Dcx), restored CA1 delta/theta LFP power, increased phosphatidylcholine levels, and improved neurological score and Y-maze alternation in TBI mice relative to the untreated TBI model group.

exposures.label: LIPUS treatment following controlled cortical impact TBI

target.label: unfocused ultrasound transducer applied over the head (effects assessed in hippocampal CA1)

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS delivered via an unfocused transducer with an active area of 3.5 cm^2 for a total stimulation duration of 10 min daily; per the Figure 2 legend, treatment was applied for one week following TBI.

flags.reason: Paper states a total of 60 mice were purchased for the whole study, but the number specifically exposed to LIPUS (vs sham-operated/TBI-model-only) is only given per-experiment (e.g., n=6, n=3-6, n=3-4 mice per group) and never summed as one LIPUS-exposed total.
Total number of treatment days is not stated in the Methods (only '10 min daily'); the 'one-week' duration is stated only in the Figure 2 legend.

Methods do not state where on the head the unfocused transducer was placed or its targeting relative to the craniotomy/hippocampus; effects were assessed in hippocampal CA1 but sonication is described only as unfocused.
Device is described with a pulsed intensity metric (ISPPA) but no PRF or duty cycle is given, so continuous vs pulsed cannot be determined from the text.
Text states 'C67BL/6 N', which is likely a typographical error for the common strain C57BL/6N; recorded verbatim as written.
